description: OKX public REST market data for USDT-margined perpetual swaps (candles, trades, books, ticker, funding rates). No API key; read-only.
permission_basis: Public market data served without authentication by OKX public REST endpoints (/market/candles, /market/history-candles), used for research only; raw payloads are not redistributed. OKX Terms of Service reviewed 2026-11-18. This registry entry is an explicit research-use assertion, not a legal determination.
timestamp_basis: Exchange event time: candle open time in UTC milliseconds; a candle's values become knowable at its close (open + bar duration). Daily bars open at 16:00 UTC.
